title: Restriction compatibility of the constructed open-section comparisons
statement: For $X,F,i$ as in [new-etale-tensor-open-section-iso], let $e_U$ denote the constructed comparison there. For every open inclusion $V\subseteq U$, the tensor-section restriction $\rho$ [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial] satisfies $\rho\circ e_V=e_U\circ F(U\to V)$ in diagrammatic composition order. Equivalently, the square with tensor sections above, ordinary additive sections [def-sc-module-cech-comparison] below, and vertical maps $e_U,e_V$ commutes. No component isomorphism is asserted here: these are the fixed, already constructed maps.

proof.text: Use hi on objects and arrows to replace i by the underlying open-subscheme inclusions. The morphisms over X become the canonical inclusions because restrictionFunctor maps an inclusion to Scheme.homOfLE.

For inclusions a:V to U and b:U to X, the unit equation of the mate defining tensorSectionsComp identifies the successive tensor units with the unit for a followed by b. Apply the unit equation of leftAdjointUniq for the explicitly constructed comparisons e. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence identifies the resulting composite with the restriction-unit composite.

Evaluate this equality at top sections. restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app is ordinary restriction; restrictAppIso and image-top transports identify the source and target sections with F(U) and F(V). Functoriality of F.presheaf identifies the equality transports and proves the naturality square.
